# Elf Match

> Elf Match is a free Secret Santa generator. An organizer names an exchange, chooses a currency, invites people by link or email, keeps particular pairs from matching, and sends each person a private assignment.

Elf Match is for a family or an office that is not in one room. A draw needs at least three people who have joined. After the organizer confirms, the names cannot be redrawn. A wishlist is readable by its author, and after the draw only by the assigned giver.
